screen.name: MessageBoxSimple
screen.applet: from enigma import eSize, ePoint if self.timerRunning: titleheight = 40 else: titleheight = 0 self.setTitle("") orgwidth = self.instance.size().width() orgheight = self.instance.size().height() orgpos = self.instance.position() textsize = self["text"].getSize() if textsize[0] < textsize[1]: textsize = (textsize[1], textsize[0]) textsize = (textsize[0] + 101, textsize[1] + 40) wsizex = textsize[0] + 120 wsizey = textsize[1] lenlist = len(self.list)*51 if (lenlist > 253): lenlist = 253 if (128 > wsizey): wsizey = 128 if self.type == self.TYPE_YESNO: wsizey += lenlist + 20 if (560 > wsizex): wsizex = 560 wsize = (wsizex, wsizey + titleheight) self.instance.resize(eSize(*wsize)) self["text"].instance.move(ePoint(129, int(16 + titleheight))) self["text"].instance.resize(eSize(*textsize)) if "ErrorPixmap" in self: self["ErrorPixmap"].instance.move(ePoint(9, int(9 + titleheight))) self["ErrorPixmap"].instance.resize(eSize(107,107)) if "QuestionPixmap" in self: self["QuestionPixmap"].instance.move(ePoint(9, int(9 + titleheight))) self["QuestionPixmap"].instance.resize(eSize(107,107)) if "WarningPixmap" in self: self["WarningPixmap"].instance.move(ePoint(9, int(9 + titleheight))) self["WarningPixmap"].instance.resize(eSize(107,107)) if "InfoPixmap" in self: self["InfoPixmap"].instance.move(ePoint(9, int(9 + titleheight))) self["InfoPixmap"].instance.resize(eSize(107,107)) if "icon" in self: self["icon"].instance.move(ePoint(9, int(9 + titleheight))) self["icon"].instance.resize(eSize(107,107)) if self.type == self.TYPE_YESNO: listsize = (wsizex-8, lenlist) self["list"].instance.move(ePoint(4, int(wsizey - lenlist + titleheight - 4))) self["list"].instance.resize(eSize(*listsize)) newwidth = wsize[0] self.instance.move(ePoint(int(orgpos.x() + (orgwidth - newwidth) // 2), int(orgpos.y() + (orgheight - wsizey) // 2)))
